nodes.description: Public contest identifier derived from contest meta data.
Address of the contest creator, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Public address of the referee who may disqualify/requalify participants.
Public provider address that receives the provider fee.
Public array of all participant addresses.
Public array of all voter addresses.
Public array of winning participants, kept sorted by vote count.
Public array of voters that won a prize.
Public sum of prizes paid out; also used as closed flag.
Public mapping tracking whether an address already participated.
Public mapping tracking whether an address already voted.
Public mapping of votes per candidate.
Public mapping of disqualified participants.
Public timestamp of the participation deadline.
Public timestamp of the voting deadline.
Public participation fee in wei.
Public voting fee in wei.
Public provider fee in basis points of 10000.
Public prize share for the owner in basis points of 10000.
Public prize share for the referee in basis points of 10000.
Public array of prize shares for each winner position.
Public number of lucky voters to be drawn.
Payable constructor setting c4c, owner, deadlines, fees, prizes and validating the sum of prizes.
Payable function adding msg.sender to the participant list before the participation deadline.
Payable function registering a vote for a candidate between the deadlines.
Internal helper returning the index of a candidate in the winners array.
Referee-only function marking a candidate as disqualified.
Referee-only function clearing the disqualified flag of a candidate.
Closes the contest after the voting deadline and distributes the prizes.
Determines the winning voters using pseudo-random numbers.
Internal helper producing a pseudo-random number from blockhash.
Internal function distributing the contract balance amongst all parties.
Constant function returning the total number of votes.
Caller address, attacker-controllable untrusted input.
Current block timestamp (now), miner-influenced untrusted input.
Original transaction sender, untrusted input used to reject contract callers.
External send of the provider fee to c4c before totalPrize is set.
External send of the owner prize computed with unchecked arithmetic.
External send of the referee prize.
External send of each winner prize inside a loop.
External send to lucky voters inside a loop.
External send of the remaining balance to the owner when there are no lucky voters.
Weak pseudo-randomness source based on block.blockhash.

Local accumulator of all prize shares in the constructor.

Local random index in determineLuckyVoters().

edges.reason: msg.sender sets participated[msg.sender] in participate().
msg.sender is pushed onto the participants array.
msg.sender is pushed onto the winners array when space remains.
block.timestamp is compared to deadlineParticipation to gate participation.
block.timestamp is compared to deadlineVoting in vote() and close() (timestamp dependency).
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender to restrict participation to wallets.
msg.sender is pushed onto the voters array in vote().
msg.sender sets voted[msg.sender] in vote().
The candidate parameter indexes numVotes which is incremented.
vote() calls getCandidatePosition() to locate the candidate.
close() calls determineLuckyVoters().
close() calls distributePrizes() when the balance is sufficient.
distributePrizes() performs an external send to c4c before totalPrize is set.
distributePrizes() performs an external send of the owner prize.
distributePrizes() performs an external send of the referee prize.
distributePrizes() performs external sends to winners inside a loop.
distributePrizes() performs external sends to lucky voters inside a loop.
distributePrizes() sends the entire remaining balance to the owner.
randomNumberGen() uses block.blockhash as pseudo-randomness.
determineLuckyVoters() calls randomNumberGen() in a loop.
determineLuckyVoters() populates the luckyVoters array.
msg.sender is the untrusted caller of participate().
msg.sender is the untrusted caller of vote().
disqualify() is gated by the comparison msg.sender == referee.
requalify() is gated by the comparison msg.sender == referee.
disqualify() sets disqualified[candidate] to true.
requalify() sets disqualified[candidate] to false.
distributePrizes() assigns the current balance to totalPrize.
totalPrize/10000*prizeOwner is unchecked arithmetic (division before multiplication, overflow risk).
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting privileged rights.
Constructor sets the c4c provider address.
Constructor sets deadlineParticipation.
Constructor sets deadlineVoting.
Constructor sets participationFee.
Constructor sets votingFee.
The c4c fallback could reenter close() before totalPrize is set, re-running distribution.

Parameter candidate only used within getCandidatePosition().
Parameter startindex only used within getCandidatePosition().
Parameter candidate only used within disqualify(); it maps into the disqualified state var.
Parameter candidate only used within requalify(); it maps into the disqualified state var.
Parameter nonce only used to index block.blockhash inside randomNumberGen().
Parameter range is the modulo operand inside randomNumberGen().
Local accumulator only used inside the constructor Contest().
Loop counter scoped to the constructor Contest().
Outer loop counter scoped to vote().
Inner loop counter scoped to vote().
Local nonce counter scoped to determineLuckyVoters().
Local random index scoped to determineLuckyVoters().
Local payout amount computed and used in distributePrizes() external sends.
Loop counter over winners scoped to distributePrizes().
Loop counter over luckyVoters scoped to distributePrizes().
